subject.title: fix(crabbox): retry cold metadata probes so a slow run --help does not block validation

question: Should the Crabbox wrapper accept one 20s retry per startup metadata probe, even though a truly unusable binary can now take roughly 50s to reject?
rationale: This is an operational tolerance tradeoff for maintainer validation infrastructure; CI cannot prove the acceptable latency budget on all runners.

options.title: Accept the retry budget
options.body: Merge as-is if avoiding transient cold-probe failures is worth the slower failed-binary path.

options.title: Tune the retry
options.body: Reduce the retry timeout or scope it to `run --help` if the extra failed-binary wait is too costly.

recommendation.title: Accept the retry budget
recommendation.body: Merge as-is if avoiding transient cold-probe failures is worth the slower failed-binary path.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has prior merged history in the Crabbox wrapper timeout surface and authored the current operational tradeoff.
